item.title: [7.1] Sebi unveils six-tier credit risk-o-meter for debt securities
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

item.title: [6.9] The $95 barrel behind RBI’s inflation rethink
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Reserves have fallen to $734.6 billion in the week ended October 2, the fourth consecutive week of fall and down from a recent peak of $785.71 billion reported on September 4, ‌according to a footnote to governor Sanjay Malhotra's monetary policy statement on Wednesday. The latest reserve numbers were released earlier than the scheduled date of October 9.

WHY IT MATTERS

The consecutive sharp decline in RBI's foreign exchange reserves highlights emerging macroeconomic pressures from rising commodity prices that impact India's monetary policy trajectory.
